title: Bacteria that talk: the squid and its light
title_es: Bacterias que hablan: el calamar y su luz
subtitle: Light only when there are many
objective: Show how marine bacteria switch on their light only when they are numerous, by sensing a signal they release.
objective_es: Muestra cómo unas bacterias marinas encienden su luz solo cuando son numerosas, detectando una señal que ellas mismas liberan.
description: One bacterium alone does not glow. Many together do: each one releases a signal, and when the signal builds up, they all switch on their light at once.
description_es: Una bacteria sola no brilla. Muchas juntas sí: cada una libera una señal y, cuando la señal se acumula, todas encienden su luz a la vez.

organism.description: A bacterium that lives in a squid and lights up.
organism.description_es: Una bacteria que vive en un calamar y se ilumina.

exploration.label: The squid
exploration.title: A lamp against predators
exploration.description: The Hawaiian bobtail squid hosts these bacteria in a light organ. At night, its glow hides its shadow from predators below.
exploration.description_es: El calamar hawaiano de cola corta alberga estas bacterias en un órgano luminoso. De noche, su brillo oculta su sombra a los depredadores de abajo.

exploration.label: Counting
exploration.title: Quorum sensing
exploration.description: Each bacterium makes a small signal molecule. In a crowd, the signal accumulates and tells the cells that they are many.
exploration.description_es: Cada bacteria fabrica una pequeña molécula señal. En una multitud, la señal se acumula y avisa a las células de que son muchas.

exploration.label: The switch
exploration.title: A protein that listens
exploration.description: The protein LuxR binds the signal, and only then switches on the genes that make light.
exploration.description_es: La proteína LuxR se une a la señal y solo entonces enciende los genes que fabrican luz.

invalidConnections.reason: The signal does not touch the genes by itself. It acts through the LuxR protein.

invalidConnections.reason: GFP does not make its own light: it needs blue light from outside. These bacteria make light with luciferase.
invalidConnections.reason_es: La GFP no fabrica luz propia: necesita luz azul de fuera. Estas bacterias fabrican luz con luciferasa.

winCondition.description: Let the signal build up so that the bacteria switch on their light together.
winCondition.description_es: Deja que la señal se acumule para que las bacterias enciendan su luz a la vez.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: There are two parts: a chain that makes the signal, and a chain that responds to it by making light.
hints.content_es: Hay dos partes: una cadena que fabrica la señal y otra que responde a ella fabricando luz.

hints.title: Next step
hints.content: luxI gene → enzyme → making the signal → signal → LuxR protein → light genes → luciferase → light reaction → glow.
hints.content_es: Gen luxI → enzima → fabricar la señal → señal → proteína LuxR → genes de la luz → luciferasa → reacción de la luz → brillo.

hints.title: Solution
hints.content: Connect the chain of the signal, then the signal with LuxR, LuxR with the light genes, and the second chain up to the glow.
hints.content_es: Conecta la cadena de la señal, luego la señal con LuxR, LuxR con los genes de la luz y la segunda cadena hasta el brillo.

completion.title: Bacteria that count each other
completion.summary: You followed a way in which single cells coordinate: they release a signal, sense how many they are, and act together.
completion.summary_es: Has seguido una forma en que las células solas se coordinan: liberan una señal, notan cuántas son y actúan juntas.
completion.realWorldImpact: The same idea of counting by a signal is used by many bacteria to decide when to make toxins, to form groups, or to attack, and it is an active field of research.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: La misma idea de contarse mediante una señal la usan muchas bacterias para decidir cuándo fabricar toxinas, formar grupos o atacar, y es un campo de investigación muy activo.

science.realWorldCase: In 1970 researchers showed that the luminous marine bacteria switch on their light only at high density, thanks to a substance they release, which they called an autoinducer.
science.realWorldCase_es: En 1970 unos investigadores mostraron que las bacterias marinas luminosas encienden su luz solo a alta densidad, gracias a una sustancia que liberan y que llamaron autoinductor.
science.scientificContext: LuxI synthesises an acyl-homoserine lactone. At high concentration it binds LuxR, and the complex activates transcription of the lux operon, including the luciferase genes.
science.scientificContext_es: LuxI sintetiza una acil-homoserina lactona. A alta concentración se une a LuxR y el complejo activa la transcripción del operón lux, que incluye los genes de la luciferasa.
gameplaySimplifications: The light reaction also needs oxygen and a long-chain aldehyde; they are not shown here.
gameplaySimplifications_es: La reacción de la luz también necesita oxígeno y un aldehído de cadena larga; aquí no se muestran.
